name: Schwieriges Unterfangen
summary: Langläuferin Malah’s report carries word of a new centaur camp in Mulgore. Kriegerheld Wildrunner needs to know what happened to her, who killed her, and why the camp points to a small raiding party entering the land.

sections.title: Malah's Report
sections.body: You bring Langläuferin Malah’s report to Kriegerheld Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village. He needs to know what happened to Malah and who killed her. Her report brings troubling news, and Baine must hear it at once.

aliases: who do i take it to
faq.answer: Kriegerheld Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village wants Langläuferin Malah’s report.
The report concerns what happened to Langläuferin Malah and who killed her.

faq.q: What is near the arrows' direction?
aliases: where did the raiders come from
faq.answer: A new centaur camp lies in the direction from which the arrows that struck Malah seem to have come.
Activity at the camp suggests a small raiding party has entered Mulgore.

faq.q: Who needs to hear the news?
faq.answer: Kriegerheld Wildrunner says Baine must hear the news at once.

angles.text: As a tauren, you carry news of a centaur raiding party in Mulgore to Kriegerheld Wildrunner.
